Kerala-Inspired Coconut Curry Leaf Prawns

A little spicy, super fragrant and loaded with curry leaves  this one comes together so quickly and is SO good with a crispy dosa on the side.

355 KCAL | 22G PROTEIN | 20G FAT | 22G CARBS
Serves 2

INGREDIENTS

For the curry leaf paste
• ½ cup curry leaves + extra for garnish
• 1 tbsp oil
• ¼ tsp turmeric
• 6 garlic cloves
• 2 tbsp grated coconut
• water for blending - don’t use too much 

For the prawns
• 200g prawns, peeled & deveined
• 1 tbsp Greek yogurt / hung curd
• 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
• ¼ tsp black pepper

For cooking
• 1 tsp coconut oil
• 1 tsp mustard seeds
• 2 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 onion, thinly sliced
• 2 green chillies, slit
• 1½ tsp coriander powder
• Salt
• Extra curry leaves

METHOD

1. Sauté curry leaves in oil until bright green and fragrant. Don’t let them brown.
2. Blend the curry leaves, turmeric, garlic and coconut with 1 tsp water until smooth.
3. Marinate the prawns with Greek yogurt, ginger-garlic paste and pepper.
4. Heat coconut oil and add mustard seeds. Once they pop, add onion and sauté until golden.
5. Add garlic, green chillies and coriander powder. Sauté for 30 seconds.
6. Add the prawns and toss for a minute.
7. Add the curry leaf paste, fresh curry leaves and salt. Toss and cook for 3–4 minutes, until the prawns are just cooked.
8. Finish with extra curry leaves and serve hot with a crispy dosa.

SAVE THIS FOR THE NEXT TIME YOU WANT SOMETHING THAT FEELS FANCY BUT TAKES 15 MINUTES 🤌🏽

PRO TIP: Don’t overcook the prawns — the second they’re opaque and curled, they’re done!
